findings.title: External evidence lifecycle is incomplete and not cryptographically bound to the consumed capability operation
No finalized roadmap exists and the historical roadmap contradicts finalized prompts
The runtime policy binds to a condensed derivative instead of the supplied governing Master Operating Prompt
Trusted executables, signing material, runtime root and journal anchor remain caller-selectable through environment
Nonce database and signed journal are not crash-atomic
Validation snapshot has a pathname TOCTOU race that can validate wrong bytes or copy ignored secrets
Controller child output and result payload resource limits/redaction are incomplete
Evidence keyring and external evidence input are not fully protected by the policy/TOCTOU boundary
The implementation bundle is not a deployable, self-consistent trusted installation
Operator key generation can overwrite a symlink target and supply-chain hardening remains incomplete
Changed-byte budget measures final file sizes rather than aggregate actual diff
Security tests cover many controls but miss the highest-risk composed failure paths

regression_test_status.description: Approval documents previously required their own final hash.
regression_test_status.justification: Approval documents are excluded from the policy set they sign; independent approval matrix passed and policy mutation failed.

regression_test_status.description: Nonce consumption was not atomic across concurrent runs.
regression_test_status.justification: Thread/process uniqueness is closed, but crash/anchor atomicity across SQLite and journal is not.

regression_test_status.description: Signed state was not bound to exact repository HEAD/tree and exact roadmap/policy hashes.
regression_test_status.justification: HEAD/tree, roadmap, prompt catalog and core controller hashes are bound; evidence keyring/schema/install identities and canonical governing policy are incomplete.

regression_test_status.description: No trusted external-evidence ingestion and immutable registration path existed.
regression_test_status.justification: Registry exists but controller nonce registration is unreachable and exact operation/evidence binding is incomplete.

regression_test_status.description: Controller-owned writes could follow repository symlinks.
regression_test_status.justification: Descriptor-relative secure writes and symlink-ancestor tests pass.

regression_test_status.description: Git operations could execute repository-controlled hooks, filters, signing tools, helpers, or hostile configuration.
regression_test_status.justification: Repository config vectors are blocked, but caller-selected Git executable permits arbitrary host code.

regression_test_status.description: External-runner trust roots were caller-selectable.
regression_test_status.justification: Production launcher design rejects CLI trust roots, but no installed attested launcher is supplied and controller trust roots remain environment-selected.

regression_test_status.description: Appendix A accepted an identifier without cryptographically verified human authorization.
regression_test_status.justification: Signed, bound authorization verification exists; invented ID fails.

regression_test_status.description: Signed journals lacked rollback/truncation resistance.
regression_test_status.justification: External anchoring detects rollback when configured, but is optional/caller-selected and crash recovery is absent.

regression_test_status.description: Agent-writable and controller-owned paths were not fully separated.
regression_test_status.justification: Agent diff is checked before controller-owned materialization and protected writes are separate.

regression_test_status.description: Path budgets did not cap aggregate actual diff and untracked files.
regression_test_status.justification: Path count and untracked files are covered; byte accounting is final-size, not actual patch/deletion volume.

regression_test_status.description: Validation snapshots could include ignored secrets and local artifacts.
regression_test_status.justification: Static ignored files are excluded, but pathname TOCTOU can copy ignored secret content.

regression_test_status.description: Child stdout/stderr and evidence resources were insufficiently bounded.
regression_test_status.justification: Validator/adapter limits improved; controller child output and result JSON remain unbounded.

regression_test_status.description: Signer-role separation could be satisfied without one distinct signer per required role.
regression_test_status.justification: Distinct identity assignment is enforced and tested.

regression_test_status.description: External adapter verification had path ownership and TOCTOU weaknesses.
regression_test_status.justification: Adapter fd/hash execution closes the reported replacement path in the submitted design/tests.

regression_test_status.description: ROLLED_BACK could be represented as an apply success.
regression_test_status.justification: Rollback maps to non-success and failed evidence cannot satisfy release audit.

regression_test_status.description: Signed evidence files could be overwritten.
regression_test_status.justification: Content-addressed create-once storage and evidence-ID uniqueness are enforced.

regression_test_status.description: Generated reports and result payloads lacked strict limits and centralized redaction.
regression_test_status.justification: Some limits/redaction exist, but multiple arrays/objects and total JSON/controller output remain unbounded.

regression_test_status.description: Security tests did not cover the highest-risk trust boundaries.
regression_test_status.justification: Coverage expanded to 30 tests, but independent testing found 10 omitted vulnerabilities.

regression_test_status.description: Supply-chain and operator-tool hardening was incomplete.
regression_test_status.justification: Dependency locks lack hashes, production installation artifacts are placeholders, and keygen follows public-output symlinks.
